title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into the Malware data model. Another authenticated user accessing the Malware Search dashboard could trigger execution of attacker-controlled SPL commands with their permissions due to improper quoting of row values in drilldown searches. This could lead to exposure of data accessible to the user and insertion of malicious records into an index.
